notes.title: Frequently Asked Questions 🥁
notes.notes:
[h3]Although Ragnarock has no more secrets for most of you Vikings, there are still a few raiders out there seeking guidance to master the beat. We figured there was no better way to start the year than by gathering the most frequently asked questions into one dedicated article. Whether you're a new challenger or a hammer-wielding veteran, this FAQ has got you covered![/h3]

[h1]1️⃣Can I play Ragnarock without VR?[/h1]
Absolutely! The game has been available on PC since 2023. So grab a controller or a keyboard and drum your way through the rocking playlist curated with love.

[h1]2️⃣Can we play in a local multiplayer mode?[/h1]
Yes, there is a split screen mode available in the [u]Steam PC version[/u]. Get comfortably seated in your living room with your friends and compete against up to 3 of them. Note that VR players won’t be able to join.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38879909/07227d7776a7a74614d1f197c5b5157ad0406bf3.png[/img]

[h1]3️⃣In online multiplayer, are we playing against VR and PC players?[/h1]
In online multiplayer, you are playing against both types of players by default. You can choose to play only against players from your platform by going to the [i]Advanced Settings[/i] and selecting whichever option feels better to you.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38879909/baff1f747c7240080ac14c03c81bc3477737567e.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38879909/ecb7b3f82298c5f6f8288e5bd225a3797b8184a3.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38879909/4683721ac37a050b940773d9aa48ca36a9a8b7d1.png[/img]

[h1]4️⃣What can I do to improve my scoring?[/h1]
[list][*] Add [b]beat lines[/b] to help you keep up with the tempo by going to the [i]Settings [/i]right before a song starts.[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38879909/ed519f8fe08edf3ae9b8ec602215f24f95c06a5d.png[/img]

[list][*] Change your [b]rune speed[/b] to your liking so you can anticipate more easily what’s coming. This setting is right below the [i]Display beat lines[/i] one and can be changed from one song to the other.[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38879909/7110e9051c312cb24e96fd6554e36ea70175dbb2.png[/img]

[list][*] Turning[b] down Drum sound compensation[/b] in the [i]Advanced Settings[/i]. This will allow you to hear exactly when you hit the drum, rather than the corrected, more in sync, drum sound. This can help you realize whether you hit too early/too late.[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38879909/4d871c971b957bce297fe857bc07faee4a321628.png[/img]

[i]You can find more tips on how to improve your scoring [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2734005345]here[/url].[/i]


[h1]5️⃣[i]VR Only [/i]: Can I change the drums’ position?[/h1]
Yes, you can choose to place the drums in an [b]arc position[/b] if you feel like it would help you aim for the runes more easily. Go to the [i]Advanced Settings[/i] to enable the option and then place the drums however you want by going to the [i]Display setting[/i] right before a song starts.

[h1]6️⃣Can I turn off the vikings in my boats?[/h1]
Yes, in the [i]Audio settings[/i] just lower the voice to 0 and you’ll have a quiet ride !

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38879909/30d12ca0d4cb0932b42dc7e7f284ba77f0fdc5c5.png[/img]

[h1]7️⃣Are the DLC available offline?[/h1]
Only the base game and its 46 songs are available to play offline.

[h1]8️⃣How many songs are available in the game?[/h1]
46 songs are available in the base game.
38 more are part of Raids (DLC) so that makes 84 songs in total.

[i]You can find the links to the DLCs [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1345820/discussions/0/4691153621053548587/]here[/url].[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38879909/abe138b6b9f07f035eb68e267f21bb97e6082312.png[/img]


You can find more questions about the game in general [url=https://www.ragnarock-game.com/faq]here[/url].


If you still have questions or if some of those answers aren't helpful enough, don't hesitate to write us either here, on our [url=https://discord.gg/kVq4sXS]Discord[/url], or by email at contact@wanadevstudio.com.

Keep rocking on !

notes.title: The Ragnarock V1 release is now available!
notes.notes:
Ahoy fellow vikings!

Today is the day! After almost 7 months of Early Access, we’re very happy and proud to release the V1 version of Ragnarock, accompanied by a multitude of additional musical content, a new environment and awesome new features, which will continue to be extended over time.

[previewyoutube=qC5LeAVzDlM;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]What you will find in the Muspelheim update[/h2]

[h3]6 new epic tracks![/h3]

Because songs are the heart of this rhythm game, we are happy to announce the arrival of 6 new awesome tracks in addition to the previous 24!

To begin with, we are proud to announce a new collaboration with [b]Alestorm[/b], a pirate metal staple, with the arrival of "[i]No grave but the sea[/i]" on the tracklist.

Because there is nothing better than a bit of crazy metal music, Ragnarock players will now be able to smash runes on [i]Kammthaar [/i] and [i]Evier Metal[/i] by the ones we don't even introduce anymore: [b]Ultra Vomit[/b]!

[b]Saltatio Mortis[/b], who has long been requested by the community, also joins the list of bands participating in Ragnarock. The German folk metal group is therefore arriving with two new tracks: [i]Loki[/i] (obviously!) and [i]Löwenherz[/i]!

Finally, because everyone loved sweating like never before on “[i]The Great Pirate Bottle[/i]” by Sabordage, Ragnarock welcomes a new bespoke track by [b]Sabordage[/b], “[i]Au Petit Matin[/i]”, has been added to the list of available songs!

[h3]A new environment: travel to Muspelheim![/h3]

Since the first environment (Midgard), we've always wanted to add immersive content inspired by Norse mythology. The most observant will have noticed a logic of continuity between the different playable maps, and of course, a correlation between tracks and environments.

[b]Muspelheim [/b]thus joins this list of 6 different environments. Muspelheim is the world of fire, kingdom of the giant Surtr... and we wanted to do something awesome!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38879909/8cc0817b0c4cc5bba724058d26a7498799862634.jpg[/img]
[i]Muspelheim artwork[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38879909/0c99b26b641ef979f0886a7f0bcb0cadd61f4aae.jpg[/img]
[i]Muspelheim artwork[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38879909/9e3458ef48fad64713a36080a972e267be597cb7.png[/img]

[h3]New features to discover, train, collect and have fun![/h3]

[b]Achievements![/b]

Unlock [b]Achievements [/b]to get great rewards: new epic and playable hammer pairs will be added to your collection. You can now change hammers using the selector on the right in the tavern. Please note that the differences between hammers are only visual and do not affect gameplay. [b]Collect them all![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38879909/118f39a96bdb785fb8c6a7f42707dd5eab68744f.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38879909/f23668462c45b2cfd5a9e95c504e67b8fb77bca5.png[/img]

[b]A new Practice Mode to become the best![/b]

Check the “Practice Mode” checkbox at the start of a song or in the Pause Menu (in Solo) to choose your speed and the sequence you want to practice! (Please note that when using Practice Mode, medals and high scores are not saved. Ghosts are also not available in Practice Mode.)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38879909/691545301b5cce695f6cb9887a9b14e9987a1a34.png[/img]

[b]Communicate thanks to emojis![/b]

At the start and end of a multiplayer race, you will find behind you a forge of emojis allowing you to share your emotions with other players in an easy and fun way!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38879909/339db98e3515ad8878cfee074d3008ebcac3791e.png[/img]

[b]... and a lot of new fixes and optimization stuff![/b]

[list]

[h2]What happened during Early Access[/h2]

During these almost seven months of Early Access, Ragnarock has gone through a lot of improvements, heavily influenced by the players’ feedback and needs.

[list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38879909/03dc268ad10f9fcbb1fbf421226fba02b946fa8d.jpg[/img]

[*] [h3][b]3 New Songs[/b][/h3] 
Masters of the Galaxy by Gloryhammer (level 3/5/9), Tortuga by Alestorm (level 3/5/7) and Welcome to Asgard by Manaberry (level 1/3/6), an original creation for Ragnaröck. Here are some more amazing songs to bang your drums to! Rest assured that we are working hard in order to keep adding more in the upcoming months.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38879909/ed5a8e01c83677cbc2bc33dc2198df2a9ce61a2b.jpg[/img]

[*] [h3][b]Improved Leaderboards[/b][/h3]
- Display [b]detailed stats[/b] of high scores when hovering the Leaderboard (in lobby)
- Additional [b]Leaderboard with Steam friends[/b] only (in lobby)
- Blue and yellow combos counted separately on score panel and in stats
[i]Please note to support these new features (and the new ghosts), Leaderboards, high scores and medals have been reset.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38879909/50124810683669ea099a173cda26182377868e8c.jpg[/img]

[*] [h3][b]More Ghost Options[/b][/h3]
[b]Five more ghosts[/b] are now available in solo (on top of your Personal best) on each song/level:
- Song Top #1 [i](from global leaderboard)[/i]
- Player ranked 10 places above you [i](from global leaderboard)[/i]
- Player ranked 5 places above you [i](from global leaderboard)[/i]
- Top #1 amongst your friends [i](from Friends leaderboard)[/i]
- Friend ranked above you [i](from Friends leaderboard)[/i]
You can choose which ghosts are activated and against which one your distance is compared (panel at the front of your boat) in the Ghost settings. Get ready for solo races with up to 6 real adversaries!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38879909/2af2871bab4d9d4f79258a7a8f85eba4243798d2.jpg[/img]

[*][h3] [b]Improved Multiplayer[/b][/h3]
- [PvP Quickplay] Display [b]list of available servers and their status[/b]: number of players, song playing, time remaining
- [PvP Quickplay] Public servers now have a [b]difficulty range [/b](displayed in the list). Songs and votes can only be chosen in this range.
- [PvP Quickplay] You can create a new server with your own difficulty range and choose the first song. You can play alone on a server while waiting for other players.
- [PvP Quickplay AND Private] [b]Join the race mid-song[/b] even if it has already started (good luck catching up to the others!)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38879909/e4cac43087f03a987a7297fb5aa92cadefce5893.jpg[/img]

[*] [h3][b]Improved Quick Menu (during a song)[/b][/h3]
- In solo, opening the menu [b]pauses [/b]the game (you can't pause a PvP race of course)
- Drums and hammers settings are now available in the Quick menu
- On Oculus headsets, you must now press the Menu button on the left controller to open the Quick menu

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38879909/9512e34db4208882df798241f7c0ddfed097535a.jpg[/img]

[*] [h3][b]New Sound Engine[/b][/h3]
[b]Better audio synchronization[/b], using the [b][i]fmod [/i][/b]sound engine. This is intended to solve the sync problems between music and rune hits that some players told us about (and for which they used the latency setting to compensate). It also allows us to add cool new features now and in the future (like Pause).
[i]Please note your previous latency settings are now obsolete. We advise you to reset the latency to zero before playing (see Advanced settings).[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38879909/345c8226156ebfc73e4cc12c6bb643f57e0094fd.png[/img]

[*] [h3][b]New “Advanced” Settings[/b][/h3]
- moved[b] “Latency”[/b] setting there
- new setting to[b] show latency[/b] in your score panel (disabled by default)
- new setting to adjust the [b]“Drum sound compensation” [/b](0% : Play the drum sound exactly when you hit (more accurate), 100% : Play the drum sound exactly on the beat (more ear-pleasing), Default: 70%)
- Setting [b]“Skip intro”[/b] to bypass the logo/splash screens on startup
- Setting [b]“Hide hands”[/b] to remove hand models on your hammers during game

- [b]“Viewer cameras”[/b] can now be activated and chosen from this menu (multiple viewpoints available). This feature allows you to display external camera views on your monitor, independently from your VR view. It can be used to :
[list]
[*]Provide a more [b]comfortable viewing experience[/b] for spectators, either on your couch or during livestreams
[*]Create entertaining [b]gameplay videos[/b] with multiple camera angles and movements
[*][b]Record[/b] yourself playing from a different point of view to improve your technique or give us specific feedback
[/list]
[i]Warning : Please note this feature may cause performance issues. If you had already activated external cameras using the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2257339273]Steam guide[/url] (now updated), please note your camera settings will be reset and you must activate them again through the in-game settings.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38879909/18def3f07e5b327ee3450459838d32983da4e4c7.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38879909/67e755d7143019975fc383ff752dae153f2d0fef.jpg[/img]

[*] [b]New “Empty” environment[/b]: Just the sea and you, nothing else in sight. Can be useful for performance issues or motion sickness problems.
[*] More stable ghost (accurate position, no jumps)
[*] Smoother end of song (speed decreases but points are still counted until two seconds after the last rune)

[*] Clicking on the parchment on the right of the throne displays Game Credits

notes.title: Gameplay tips : learn how to combo !
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38879909/e031fdb1acc2dc4a70989c1bdf05f72f2dd48467.jpg[/img]

From the first seconds in Ragnaröck, you immediately understand that you have to hit the drums to break the runes that come towards you in sync with the music. But what is not immediately obvious, is that a secondary mechanic allows you to increase your score and overtake your opponents: the use of streak bonuses, or "combos".

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38879909/218061602ff23aae0a1b51e850a52a2471fe357f.jpg[/img]

If you manage to hit rune after rune without going wrong, a combo gradually loads up along the handle of your hammers. When this gauge is full, the combo bonus becomes usable. Yes, when your hammers have a fully charged combo, you can strike on one of the shields at your side to send all that accumulated energy to your rowers and get a speed boost of a few seconds!

[h2]Tip #1[/h2]

That’s not all! If you don't use your bonus right away, and continue to hit flawlessly, the combo will continue to charge a second gauge, this time on the hammerhead, until it reaches a second bonus level! The bonus generated when you reach this second step is four times more powerful and will give you a much greater speed boost!

[h2]Tip #2[/h2]

A perfect hit on a rune (perfectly in the middle of the drum, so perfectly in sync with the music) is symbolized by golden lightning bolts on the drum when crushing the rune. You should know that perfect hits load your combo twice as fast as a regular hit!

[h2]Tip #3[/h2]

Be careful, any mishit will drop the combo down to zero, and make you lose the bonus obtained if there was one. You will therefore have to calculate the risks and your chances of success!
For example, before a complicated series of notes, will you take the risk of continuing to increase your combo to level 2, or would you rather secure the level 1 bonus by using it right away?

[b]What will be your strategy to optimize your score and overtake your opponents in the viking ship race?
[/b]

notes.title: About the core gameplay
notes.notes:
[h2]Vikings, and big epic music[/h2]

In Ragnaröck, you play as a Viking ship captain determined to lead their crew to victory against their rivals. To finish the race in front of the others, you must motivate your rowers to give all their strength to move your boat forward. And all that, to the rhythm of epic music playing ([url=https://store.steampowered.com/newshub/app/1345820/view/2900842955977610974]here [/url]and [url=https://store.steampowered.com/newshub/app/1345820/view/2915478385429525164]here[/url])!

[h2]Core gameplay[/h2]

Since you are the leader of your boat, it's up to you to set the pace! You are equipped with hammers, ready to be struck with drive on the drums in front of you. The challenge ? Follow the rhythm of the luminous runes coming in! Achieving this throughout the song is the key to ensure unwavering support from your crew.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38879909/d6d087e24d70d31c90238939d4c90aad9a576f8b.jpg[/img]

Crushing the runes on your drums with your hammers is good, but doing it perfectly in sync is better! The more precise you are, the faster your ship will move. Only your final score, representing the distance covered over the duration of the song, will be proof of your success.

[h2]Varied difficulty levels for more fun and challenge[/h2]

Each track will have you playing different combinations and rhythms, as well as several levels of difficulty. The hardest ones may even make you lose your mind ... and your arms! And yet, you won't have the right to make mistakes, or you will risk losing your crew... and all of your speed.

notes.title: Art direction : about our work
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38879909/26baee51e81370ea1cc346b191c743d674fcb838.jpg[/img]

In this article, we will detail our artistic approach regarding the environment that players will discover in Ragnaröck. It’s our art director for the Ragnaröck project, Suzanne, who talks about it best. First of all, let's take a quick look at her daily work :

[previewyoutube=BUsJUMepaX4;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Low Poly: an assumed graphic style[/h2]

We decided to work on a style called “Low Poly”, both raw and pleasant, which we could, by shortcut, associate with a “cartoon” style.

This style is accessible and inviting. It insists on the “all ages” and playful side. It also allows you to distance yourself from reality. The representation is minimalist and simplified as much as possible, which helps bring clarity to the reading of a scene.

[h2]Thematic coherence and artistic impact[/h2]

In Ragnaröck, we are situated in the Nordic and mythological universe, and we want players to be able to make this universe their own.

The evolution of the scenery as the game progresses tells an epic story. Several mythological elements are thus embedded in the first map of the game, such as gigantic monster skeletons, or Yggdrasil, the tree of nine worlds. The more the players fight to improve their score, the more they advance, and the more they reveal the universe.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38879909/37a1bb76843369909f5450a61df19c466f4af622.jpg[/img]

In this first map, the blue and purple colors were chosen to refer to the land of the cold, Niflheim. In contrast, the houses and everything that refers to the Viking world have warm colors: orange, red, brown (complementary color to blue).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38879909/7a43161a8f79388e3a689535c92ba53f0491032b.jpg[/img]

[h2]Our way of working[/h2]

The key concept is to set the general mood and the colors, and give the general direction to take.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38879909/f79c55ae61a4fb9fe1b3ed00cf1e082c97f9e7ea.gif[/img]

Here, for example, we want players to start from a familiar landscape: the Viking village lost in a fjord, dominated by an austere environment. Subsequently, players discover several atmospheres, dominated by different luminosities.

[h2]Further work[/h2]

We work on many elements of the game with this careful methodology, in order to respect a graphic and thematic consistency. Today we broached the subject of the environment, but we can also mention the characters, objects, gameplay elements… All these elements are currently being worked on, and will be visible when the game is released in Early Access, very soon.

notes.title: Try Ragnaröck for free during the Steam Game Festival
notes.notes:
We are proud to present our new VR game Ragnaröck during this Autumn 2020 edition of the Steam Game Festival !

Ragnaröck is a VR game of rhythm and skill. Your crew needs a strong viking captain who can rock hard and take risks. Lift your hammers, pound your drums to the sound of epic viking music, and set sail against your rivals in multiplayer mode! Can you outrace them all and carve your name on the leaderboard?

In this free demo, you will be able to play one song in solo mode on three levels of difficulty. Train as much as you want to beat the high scores on the worldwide leaderboard! Please note the game is at an alpha stage of development. It will release in Early Access at the end of 2020, with solo and multiplayer race modes (up to 8 players online) and an epic tracklist!
